client_steps_google:
In the Google Cloud console, make a project in the Workspace of your lab.
Turn on the Google Drive API and the Gmail API.
Set the consent screen to Internal.
Make Desktop app sign-in credentials, then copy the client ID and secret.
client_steps_notion:
At notion.so/my-integrations, make a public integration.
Give it the capability Read content only.
Copy its client ID and client secret.
